candidates.source_name: Profesia.sk — Slovak job board (banking / payments / ATM roles)
candidates.why_relevant: Dominant SK job portal; bank and PSP ads name card management systems, ATM fleet sizes, switch/processing platforms, migration projects (e.g. instant payments, digital euro readiness) and team structures. Weak-signal roadmap intelligence not published anywhere else.
candidates.legal_status: ToS likely restricts scraping; manual/low-rate review advised
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword monitoring (bankomat, platobné karty, ATM, POS, kartové centrum, platobné systémy) via site search; store ad text snapshots (ads expire fast).
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language web search + snowball from employer pages

candidates.source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — kariéra (NBS careers portal)

candidates.source_name: Združenie pre bankové karty SR (ZBK) — Slovak Bank Card Association

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/aktuality and member pages; snowball member list into actor map.

candidates.source_name: Inštitút alternatívneho riešenia sporov SBA (ARS SBA)

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Check for annual reports / documents section; if no statistics published, request by email (institutars@sbaonline.sk).

brief: Slovakia's weak-signal payments surfaces cluster around four families: job boards (Profesia.sk dominant, plus NBS careers and non-bank ATM deployer Euronet Services Slovakia) that expose system names and ATM/POS operating models; conferences without a dedicated payments congress, so figures surface inside New Retail Summit, ITAPA and Finweek agendas and their trade-press recaps; complaint and ADR bodies (NBS consumer protection, Inštitút ARS SBA as the ombudsman's successor, fininfo.sk, and the MH SR ADR register) that count disputes by product; and merchant-side lobbying via Zväz obchodu SR, SAMO and practitioner media such as Podnikajte.sk, which publish concrete card-acceptance cost figures around the mandatory-cashless/QR obligation. Zlatá minca provides an unusually clean annual census of SK card products via its nomination lists. Main weaknesses: the retail associations' primary domains remain unconfirmed, ARS SBA statistics may not be published at all, and conference programmes are ephemeral and need archival capture.
